consequence.statement: New optional capability for per-tenant OTLP-to-Loki mapping; the evidence states no operational impact.

original.statement: Loki adds support for per-tenant configuration of how OTLP data is mapped to the Loki format.

decision.reason: [ev-edfb2e66c4df] lists this under Features as adding "support for per tenant configuration" for OTLP-to-Loki mapping. That describes a new optional capability, not a changed default, a removal or a failure. Nothing in the evidence says existing setups break, are rejected or behave differently, so "none" (informational) is the faithful reading. Confidence is low because a single changelog line can't rule out side effects the PR didn't mention.
